prompts.title: Code review
Explain code
prompts.content:
Explain what this code does, step by step, for a developer unfamiliar with the codebase. Start with a one-paragraph summary, then walk through the important parts. Call out any non-obvious behavior, side effects, or gotchas.

```
{{code}}
```

prompts.title: Debug an error
Write unit tests
prompts.content:
Write unit tests for the following code using {{framework}}. Cover the happy path, edge cases (empty input, boundary values, invalid input), and error handling. Use descriptive test names that state the expected behavior. Follow the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern.

```
{{code}}
```

prompts.title: Refactor for readability
prompts.content:
Refactor this code for readability without changing its behavior. Prefer early returns over nesting, clear names over comments, and small functions over large ones. Show the refactored code, then list the changes you made and why.

```
{{code}}
```

prompts.title: Commit message
prompts.content:
Write a commit message for this diff using Conventional Commits (feat/fix/refactor/docs/test/chore). Subject line under 50 characters, imperative mood. Add a body only if the "why" isn't obvious from the subject.

```diff
{{diff}}
```

prompts.title: API design review
prompts.content:
Review this API design: {{description}}

Evaluate: naming consistency, REST/RPC conventions, error handling and status codes, pagination, versioning, backwards compatibility, and security (auth, rate limiting, input validation). Suggest concrete improvements with example requests/responses.

prompts.title: Technical doc from notes
Honest expert (no flattery)
prompts.content:
Act as a blunt, world-class expert in {{field}}. No flattery, no hedging, no "great question". If my idea is weak, say so and explain exactly why. Rank alternatives, state your confidence, and separate facts from opinion. If you don't know, say "I don't know".

My question: {{question}}

prompts.title: Summarize a long text
prompts.content:
Summarize the following text. Start with the single most important takeaway in one sentence, then 3-7 bullet points of key facts, then a short paragraph of context. Preserve concrete numbers, names, and dates. Do not add information that isn't in the source.

{{text}}
